title: Revit Appendix E Source Inventory

child_assets.title: Titleblock Standards — Instruction Set
child_assets.notes: Atomic/testable instructions for controlled titleblock families, project information, sheet creation, numbering/naming, required titleblock parameters, Revit revision system, and pre-issue QA. Parent sheet numbering syntax remains governed by the parent source and is not promoted here.

child_assets.title: Workflow & Instruction Catalogue Overview
child_assets.notes: Defines workflow domains W0-W8, atomic instruction model, automation readiness, and explicit future registries. Includes W1.1 model setup, W2.2 workset management, W3 linking, W6.1 sheet setup, W7.2 QA/QC, and W8.1 exchange export. Future registries remain future, not existing assets.

child_assets.title: Navisworks Export Settings
child_assets.notes: Defines five instructions covering approved export configuration, geometry conversion, shared-coordinate positioning, property/data export, execution and evidence. Export Preset Registry is explicitly future.

child_assets.title: Revit Template Workflows JSON Governance
child_assets.notes: Defines intended template taxonomy, minimum registry fields, lifecycle gates, validation categories, distribution and audit concepts. Concrete Template Catalogue registry, Template Release Pipeline and validation ruleset are explicitly TODO and therefore do not yet exist as source authority.

child_assets.title: Shared Parameter Registry Governance Workflow
child_assets.notes: Machine-readable shared-parameter governance source; already represented in the repository shared-parameter slice.

child_assets.title: Central Shared Parameter Registry — First Citizen Set
child_assets.notes: GUID-first registry source already represented in the repository shared-parameter slice; TXT is derived, registry is authority.

child_assets.title: Build Central Shared Parameter Registry
child_assets.notes: Instruction for constructing the governed GUID-first registry from existing shared-parameter TXT sources.

child_assets.title: Generate Shared Parameter TXT from Registry
child_assets.notes: Instruction for generating controlled Revit shared-parameter TXT releases from the registry rather than treating TXT as authority.

migration_rules: Preserve source TODO, example, proposed, draft, and placeholder status.
Do not promote example codes, file patterns, role placeholders, numerical defaults, or tool settings into canonical authority without curator review.
Separate tool-independent normative requirements from Revit-specific implementation instructions.
Map Revit implementation rules back to governing S-standards rather than creating a competing authority hierarchy.
Do not create a registry or workflow merely because a governance page says it should exist; only migrate concrete source assets or create new canonical content through explicit curator action.
